basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate in computer science, currently living in Austin, Texas. By day, I juggle between working as a freelance Instacart shopper and exploring various tech-driven side projects. I'm quite fascinated with the future of human augmentation and how technology can elevate our everyday lives. Aside from my tech interests, I'm an avid fan of traditional tattoos and enjoy listening to Adam Carolla's podcast during my gig runs. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings or during breaks between batches. I'm single and enjoy my independence.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science, thanks to my recent degree and numerous online courses I've taken to keep up with the latest in technology and transhumanism. My freelance work as an Instacart shopper has also taught me a lot about logistics and customer service.
